pages.title: Toying Around

pages.title: Toying Around
pages.text: Learn toy acquisition and adjustment; cupboards and shelves display the dolls you actually obtained.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a diamond token at the lottery machine; each gift box yields its pool doll. Computer+wool creates a player doll. The tool changes scale, position and rotation; Shift speeds it, Ctrl makes it finer.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use diamond tokens at the lottery machine. Receive a gift box from the documented rarity tiers.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Open a lottery gift box. Obtain a collectible doll from its pool.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Interact with a doll using the author's squeezing action. Hear a toy-like squeak.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use wool in the Computer for a player doll; use the Tweaks Tool on an entity doll to change size, position and rotation. Customize a placed doll; Shift speeds adjustments while Ctrl makes them finer.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a doll on a block or rideable entity; sneak-right-click to throw it. Choose placement, mounting or throwing.
